rationale: Classification: infrastructure_issue because C simulation failed at link time with undefined symbol, not due to implementation bugs. Provenance hints indicate likely tester or tool config bug. Expert static review on comment-stripped source shows no violations (domain_score=0.9, synthesis_score=1.0, all constant-time properties passed). Generated static security checks (SR2, SR4, SR5) passed and agree with expert review findings (no early exits, no branches, bitwise operations present). The implementation appears correct but cannot be verified due to build configuration error. Retain decision: false because functional requirements FR1-FR5 are 'unknown' status - cannot confirm correctness without successful execution. Security requirements SR2/SR4/SR5 passed static analysis, but SR1 (timing) and SR3 (RTL iteration count) are not_run due to bambu unavailability, which is acceptable for scaffold mode but combined with failed functional verification prevents retention. Artifact to revise: tester because the linker failure indicates missing implementation file in compilation command or C/C++ linkage mismatch in testbench, not a bug in the expert implementation itself. Conservative decision: fix build infrastructure first, then re-evaluate in next round when functional tests can execute.
revision_instructions: Fix C simulation build configuration in tests/run_csim.sh and tests/tb_csim.cpp: (1) Verify compare_token.c is included in the g++ compilation command alongside tb_csim.cpp. The linker error '_compare_token' undefined indicates the implementation file is not being compiled. (2) Check for C vs C++ linkage issues - add 'extern "C"' declaration in tb_csim.cpp when including compare_token.h if the implementation is pure C. (3) Validate file paths are correct relative to the test execution directory. (4) Ensure the compilation command in run_csim.sh includes both source files: 'g++ -std=c++11 -I.. tests/tb_csim.cpp ../compare_token.c -o tb_csim'. The provenance hints correctly identified this as a tester/tool_config bug. Expert static review shows clean implementation with no violations, and generated security checks (SR2, SR4, SR5) passed and agree with expert review. Once build is fixed, re-run to verify functional requirements FR1-FR5.
